address: Cameron House Hotel, Loch Lomond, Balloch, G83 8QZ, United Kingdom
bio: Cameron House, perched on the shores of Loch Lomond, will always provide picturesque surroundings for a restaurant. Experienced chef Graeme Cheevers is the one currently taking advantage of the natural beauty, with this welcoming eatery decked out with a touch of glitz thanks to marble furnishings and mirrored panels on the ceiling. Cheevers’ ethos of well-sourced ingredients is on display, as are plenty of contrasting flavours and inspiration drawn from various Asian cuisines – such as squab pigeon with an umeboshi-flavoured jus....
